nespresso - vertuo next coffee and espre.name: Nespresso - Vertuo Next Coffee and Espresso Maker by De'Longhi, Matte Black with Aeroccino Milk Frother - Black Matte
nespresso - vertuo next coffee and espre.description: The Nespresso VERTUO NEXT coffee maker and espresso machine offers an exceptional brewing experience. It produces not only original espressos but also a remarkable cup of coffee topped with a smooth layer of crema. This versatile machine can brew various sizes, including 5, 8, 12, and 18 oz coffees, as well as single and double espressos. Included with the machine is the Nespresso Aeroccino 3 milk frother, which effortlessly creates hot or cold milk froth for your coffee recipes at the touch of a button. Nespresso's expertise in coffee selection ensures that the origin and roasting of each blend are carefully chosen. The VERTUO NEXT utilizes Centrifusion technology, a patented extraction method that blends ground coffee with water by spinning the capsule. When a Vertuo capsule is inserted, the system automatically recognizes it and adjusts brewing parameters for optimal results. Each machine comes with a complimentary welcome set of Nespresso Vertuo capsules, featuring unique aroma profiles. Customers can order capsules, receive personalized advice, and access technical support through the Nespresso mobile app, online, or at Nespresso boutiques. This coffee machine is compatible exclusively with Nespresso Vertuo pods.
